# Portal fixtures (synthetic)

These HTML pages are **written by hand**, not captured from eTenders. They
model the documented ePPS flow — login form, CfT workspace with a Messaging
tab, a message table, a compose form — so the portal account client can be
exercised without touching the live portal.

They must never be presented as proof that the client works against the real
eTenders. The connection status starts "untested" and moves to "ok"/"failed"
only after a real attempt, exactly because these fixtures are synthetic.
